Arctic Fish in brief Q3 Presentation 2026
Arctic Fish (AFISH) is one of Iceland’s 
leading salmon farmers. It is 
headquartered in Ísafjörður and 
listed on Euronext Growth in Oslo. 
Since 2023, Mowi has been the 
company’s majority owner. 

The company holds licenses for 
29,800 tonnes MAB (Maximum 
Allowed Biomass) across 10 farming 
areas in 5 fjords, all in the Westfjords 
of Iceland.
Arctic Fish controls the full value chain, from smolt to sales: 

Smolt: a state-of-the-art RAS hatchery and smolt facility at Norður-Botn in Tálknafjörður, 
producing larger, robust smolt that spend less time at sea 

Farming: attractive sea sites with high carrying capacity and high-energy equipment, all 
ASC certified 

Harvesting: a modern harvesting facility in Bolungarvík with capacity to support full license 
utilization and future growth 

The salmon is sold under the “Mowi Arctic” brand, giving access to Mowi’s global sales 
network and the substantial synergies available through the majority owner.
